Team —

Attaching v0.3 of the Mutual Action Plan for Nimbus (attached: Nimbus_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) plus the initial evaluation criteria doc (evaluation_criteria.md). We have our external kickoff with Avery on 2026-06-02 but I want us to run a quick internal pre-kick to align RACI, confirm the evaluation metrics, and lock the demo timeline.

Specific asks:
- Can each of you confirm the RACI row for your area (owner/consulted/informed) in the spreadsheet by EOD Monday (5/25)?
- Karthik: flag any technical gaps or add rows for required artifacts (sample model inputs, perf runs).
- Dev: list SOC2 / audit log artifacts we need to surface to their security team.
- Neha: I'll need procurement next steps and whether we should route procurement through channel or direct.

Proposed pre-kick meeting: Wed 5/26, 10:00–10:30 AM PT. If that doesn't work, suggest two alternatives and I'll send calendar invite. High-level milestones I'm proposing in the MAP:
- Internal pre-kick: 5/26
- Internal dry run/demo: 6/01
- Exec sponsor review (Nimbus): 6/10
- Contract signature target: 6/18

This is time-boxed — we want a clean evaluation window and a 4-week close. Please annotate the sheet directly or reply below. I'll consolidate and produce v0.4 for the customer kickoff.

Thanks,

Marissa — thanks for putting this up. Quick thread response and some inline notes I added to the sheet.

Top technical asks from my side:
- Please add an "Acceptance criteria: perf" row (latency p95 < 220ms on 8k tokens, throughput X rps) — Nimbus cares about tail latency.
- Add an embedding similarity threshold for reranking tests (cosine > 0.82 on sample queries).
- I added a deliverables row for: reproducible perf run (script + raw logs), sample requests CSV, and model config used.

Operationally: we should schedule a 45-min tech deep-dive during the internal dry run (6/01) so we can validate KV cache behavior and token accounting. I flagged that in column G.

Also — procurement will likely ask for a HIPAA/PII statement. Dev, can you confirm whether we need a data flow diagram for them?

Thanks — Karthik
